title: Overnight hold of index futures
hypothesis: NIFTY or BANKNIFTY futures bought at the close and sold at the next open, on all sessions or a conditioned subset, earn a positive return after charges.

mechanism.text: Overnight returns carry news risk while the market is shut; intraday flows push the other way.

evidence.source: Cliff, Cooper and Gulen, working paper
evidence.finding: Equity returns earned almost entirely overnight.

evidence.source: Lou, Polk and Skouras, Journal of Financial Economics 134(1)
evidence.finding: Overnight and intraday expected returns pull apart by clientele.

evidence.source: Secondary analyses of NIFTY (not peer reviewed)
evidence.finding: Most NIFTY points earned overnight, intraday sum negative.

universe.name: nifty-banknifty-futures
universe.rule: Near-month futures, close to next open.

turnover.basis: every session x 0.080% futures round trip, on notional; conditioned variants trade less

prior_trials.basis: No overnight rule has been run in this repo.

holdout_rule.pass_if: Holdout net after charges above zero.

kill_criteria: Holdout net at or below zero after charges (the expected result for every_session).
Gross overnight return below the round-trip cost per trade in validation.

prior.reason: Arithmetic: about 20% a year of charges against a single-digit gross overnight return.

feasibility.reason: Opens and closes are in the bhavcopies; #71 for history.

contamination: trader-regime and the lab's regime split read NIFTY 50 closes for 2024 to 2026; no calendar or trend rule on index futures has been run in this repo. The holdout overlaps those sessions.
